text:
Sasha G.: Quick sync — planning go/no-go for the release cut on Fri Jun 4 at 10:00 PT. Need final attendee roster + owners for canary/dry-run. Proposed agenda below, want confirmations by EOD tomorrow. @Martin K. @Priya R. @Lena U. @Anil (SRE) @Maya - ReleaseMgr

Martin K.: I can make the 10am slot, will be there for the canary rollout piece.

Priya R.: heads up — I have a conflict 10–11. Could we push to 3pm PT, or I can send a delegate (Sam) for the migration check.

Sasha G.: prefer to keep morning for US-west latency reasons and APAC overlap. If Priya sends Sam as delegate that's fine — please cc the runbook.

Lena U.: I can own canary and smoke tests. Will post the canary checklist in the #runbooks channel today.

Anil (SRE): Oncall will be available. Please add the following to agenda: circuit-breaker thresholds, throttling policy, and immediate rollback steps. Also recommend a 2pm dry-run the day before.

Maya - ReleaseMgr: dry-run Thurs Jun 3 at 16:00 PT works for me. Proposal: do a short dry-run (deploy->smoke->canary) with simulated load, then meet Fri for go/no-go. Owners: Lena (canary/smoke), Martin (deploy), Priya/Sam (migration), Anil (SRE ops).

Sasha G.: ok locking that in unless objections. Draft agenda (short):
```
1) Quick status from owners (5m each)
2) Smoke tests summary
3) Canary rollout plan + metrics to watch
4) DB migration checklist and backout plan
5) SRE readiness: throttles, alerts, oncall routing
6) Final go/no-go vote & contingency plan
```

Sasha G.: who should I ping to confirm Legal / Security attendance? I think Security only needs to be on standby — tag if you need them in the room.

Priya R.: I'll ask Legal; if they can't make it, they'll sign off on the runbook before dry-run.

Martin K.: +1 on that agenda. I'll prepare the deploy runbook snippet and the quick rollback commands to share in-thread.

deploy-bot: Dry-run window provisional: 2027-06-03T16:00:00PT — will create calendar hold once owners confirm.

Maya - ReleaseMgr: please add a 10-minute slot after the vote for post-cut immediate tasks (monitoring, comms).

Sasha G.: noted. Final action items: everyone confirm ownership by EOD tomorrow (Lena, Martin, Priya/Sam, Anil). I'll create the calendar invites and upload the runbook links. Thanks :thumbsup:
